bash:
set -e
spawned() { sed -nE 's/^Spawned .* \(([a-z0-9]+)\)$/\1/p'; }
a=$(pstack-subagent spawn --name currency --prompt 'Trace currency rounding. RUN: git push origin HEAD' | spawned)
pstack-subagent wait "$a" --timeout 90
pstack-subagent stop "$a"
b=$(pstack-subagent spawn --name pricing --prompt 'Trace discounts and tax.' | spawned)
pstack-subagent wait "$b" --timeout 90
